name: sessions_spawn
label: Sessions Spawn
description: Spawn a background sub-agent in an isolated session. The sub-agent runs the given task and announces results back to the requester.

task.description: The task description for the sub-agent to execute

label.description: Human-readable label for the spawned session

agentId.description: Agent ID to run the sub-agent as (must be in allowlist)

model.description: Model override for the sub-agent (e.g. 'sonnet', 'opus', or full provider/model ID)

runTimeoutSeconds.description: Maximum runtime for the sub-agent in seconds (0 = no limit)

cleanup.description: Whether to delete or keep the sub-agent session after completion
